request.style: English, Male solo voice, solemn choir, harp, organ, flute, cello, reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
By the Sheep Gate in Jerusalem stands a pool
Called Bethesda where the sick all are
Five covered colonnades hold the crowd
Blind and lame and paralyzed remain
Waiting for the water to be stirred
An angel comes to stir the waves
The first to step in after the stir
Is healed of whatever illness held him

[Verse]
One man there had been an invalid
For thirty-eight long years he lay
Jesus saw him lying there below
And asked if he desired to be well
The sick man answered with a sigh
I have no one to help me in
While I am on my way to the pool
Someone else goes down ahead of me

[Verse]
Jesus said to him in that hour
Get up and pick up your mat
And walk with me this very day
At once the man was made well
He picked up his mat and began to walk
Now that day was a Sabbath
The Jews said it is not permitted
To carry your mat on this holy day

[Verse]
But he answered the man who made me well
Told me to pick it up and walk
Who is the man who told you so
They asked him in the crowd
But the man who had been healed did not know
Jesus had slipped away from the place
Later Jesus found him in the temple
And spoke to him with gentle care

[Outro]
Sin no more or something worse may happen
